name: New Mexico

statute.readVia: Existing-law text as printed in 2023 HB 286 (https://www.nmlegis.gov/Sessions/23%20Regular/bills/house/HB0286.html); HB 286 was pocket-vetoed, so the bracketed (to-be-deleted) windshield text remains law. nmonesource.com could not be read.

windshield.strip: nonreflective, not red/yellow/amber, only along the top, not below the AS1 line or more than 5 in. from the top, whichever is closer to the top

frontSide.note: nonreflective; allowed only on vehicles with one right and one left outside rearview mirror

backSide.note: light transmission requirement does not apply to windows behind the driver on truck tractors, buses, recreational vehicles, multipurpose passenger vehicles or motor homes

tint.measuredHow: not explicit; light transmission defined as light passing through 'the product or material' (film), used 'in conjunction with' safety glazing
tint.dualMirrors: One right and one left outside rearview mirror required for any side or rear window tint
tint.certificateOrSticker: Manufacturer label (max 1.5 sq in.) with manufacturer name, manufacture date and % transmission, between film and glass, lower left corner of each tinted surface (viewed from outside); installing without it is prohibited

medicalExemption.text: Affidavit signed by a physician or optometrist licensed in New Mexico, kept with the person (or legal guardian) whenever transported in the vehicle; no state permit

penalty.text: Penalty assessment misdemeanor (amount in the NMSA 66-8-116 schedule, not read)

quotes: when used in conjunction with the windshield, shall be nonreflective, shall not be red, yellow or amber in color and shall [be used only along the top of the windshield, not extending downward beyond the ASI line or more than five inches from the top of the windshield, whichever is closer to the top of the windshield]

the side windows behind the driver and the rearmost window shall be nonreflective, shall have a light transmission of not less than twenty percent and shall be used only on the windows of a motor vehicle equipped with one right and one left outside rearview mirror
The light transmission requirement of this section does not apply to windows behind the driver on truck tractors, buses, recreational vehicles, multipurpose passenger vehicles or motor homes.
A person who violates a provision of this section is guilty of a penalty assessment misdemeanor.

helmet.conditions: Believed partial (under 18) under NMSA 66-7-356; official text not readable; 2026 SB 312 to change it died

handheldPhone.fineText: Texting ban exists in NMSA 66-7-374 (created 2013) per legislature bill texts; current wording/fines not read

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

openQuestions: NMSA official compilation (nmonesource.com) and nmlegis.gov blocked us; tint text is the existing-law portion of 2023 HB 286 (pocket veto) - any 2024-2026 amendment not checked
